newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian T-bills to cover state energy debt.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian T-bills to cover state energy debt.

text.p: The Lithuanian government said on Tuesday the state's debts to the state-run Lithuanian Energy company will be partly covered by the sale of T-bills in 1997.

"At the cabinet meeting on Monday...a decision was made to submit to Seimas (parliament) the draft project to cover the state's debts to Lithuania Energy, which total 776 million litas," the government said in a statement on Tuesday.
"To cover debt, government Treasury bills will be issued and other methods established by law will be used."
Lithuania's state-run energy sector is caught in a vicious cycle of debt, with consumers unable to pay producers and producers falling behind in payments to their suppliers.
